record.original_question: For the approximation-number-based classes S~_p of compact trilinear forms on Hilbert spaces, determine whether S~_p is a Banach space for finite p.

evidence.quote: It is not even clear that the spaces S~_p are Banach spaces for any p < oo.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $H_1, H_2, H_3$ be separable infinite-dimensional Hilbert spaces, and let $T: H_1 \times H_2 \times H_3 \to \mathbb{C}$ be a bounded trilinear form. Define the $n$-th approximation number of $T$ by
$$a_n(T) = \inf\{\|T - T_n\| : T_n \text{ is a trilinear form of rank at most } n\},$$
where the rank of a trilinear form is the smallest integer $r$ (if any) such that $T_n$ can be written as $\sum_{k=1}^{r} \ell_k^{(1)} \otimes \ell_k^{(2)} \otimes \ell_k^{(3)}$ for continuous linear functionals $\ell_k^{(j)}$ on $H_j$, and $\|\cdot\|$ denotes the trilinear operator norm. For $0 < p < \infty$, define the class
$$\widetilde{S}_p = \left\{T : \|T\|_{\widetilde{S}_p} := \Big(\sum_{n=1}^\infty a_n(T)^p\Big)^{1/p} < \infty\right\}.$$
Determine, for each finite $p$, whether $\widetilde{S}_p$ (equipped with the functional $\|\cdot\|_{\widetilde{S}_p}$, or an equivalent norm) is a Banach space. In particular, is the functional $\|\cdot\|_{\widetilde{S}_p}$ (or some equivalent quasi-norm) actually a norm making $\widetilde{S}_p$ complete?
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not surface a published resolution of whether the approximation-number classes $\widetilde{S}_p$ of compact trilinear forms on Hilbert spaces form Banach spaces for finite $p$. The question is explicitly noted as unresolved in the paracommutator literature, and no later work appearing in the search clearly settles it.

status_evidence.title: Paracommutators and Minimal Spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Chapter on paracommutators discussing Schatten-type classes and related structural questions.
status_evidence.claim: Related literature on paracommutators discusses Schatten-type classes but does not resolve the Banach-space question for the trilinear approximation-number classes.

status_evidence.title: An Elementary Introduction to Schatten Classes
status_evidence.snippet: Standard exposition of Schatten p-classes defined via approximation/singular numbers for linear operators on Hilbert space.
status_evidence.claim: Schatten p-classes for linear operators are Banach (for p≥1), but the analogous statement for trilinear forms is not addressed.
